text:
Maria F.: Heads-up — we received an invoice from Cohesive Cloud (INV-2026-0421) but there's no PO on the PDF. Vendor flagged that payment is due next week, asking for PO to be attached so AP can process. Can someone from the consuming team confirm?
Invoices Bot: New invoice uploaded: INV-2026-0421 • amount $12,450. Link: https://accounting.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0421 • Status: needs PO/approval.
Suresh K.: That's our service for model-hosting credits — I thought procurement created a PO for that. I don't have the PO number handy. @Tim P. do you recall?
Tim P. (Procurement): I see a related PO in the system: PO-77892 for "Model Hosting — Q1" but amount there is $10,000. This invoice is for $12,450 so maybe there was an add-on or new usage line not on the PO. Could be two things: vendor billed monthly usage vs committed PO.
Cohesive AP: Hi — thanks for the ping. Invoice INV-2026-0421 was for cloud overage + support add-on in March. We referenced PO-77892 on our side but the billing system didn't include it on the PDF. We can reissue with PO-77892 on the header if that helps.
Maria F.: Yes please reissue with PO on the header. In the meantime we need someone to confirm approver routing so we can avoid hold. @Anika — can you approve routing to the Eng budget owner once PO is confirmed?
Anika (Finance Manager): I can sign off routing once we have the reissued invoice + confirmation which cost center/GL to charge. Maria, please tell me the nominal GL if you know it.
Suresh K.: Charge GL 5002-ML-INF; cost center eng-inference. I confirm this is legitimate usage.
Tim P. (Procurement): Ok — two parallel actions: 1) Cohesive reissues invoice with PO-77892 on header (Cohesive AP), 2) Finance accepts charge to GL 5002-ML-INF and routes approval to @Anika. After that AP can match and schedule payment.
Cohesive AP: Reissue request accepted. We'll upload INV-2026-0421-R1 with PO-77892 by EOD. Apologies for the header omission.
Maria F.: Thanks. I'll hold payment put-on-hold until the reissued invoice is in the system. Once uploaded I'll unhold and route to Anika for approval.
Suresh K.: Thanks all — one ask: if the vendor's monthly usage can exceed PO in future, can procurement add a note or a higher cap on the PO to avoid manual holds?
Tim P. (Procurement): Good point. I'll follow up with the vendor on a cap/burst clause and either increase PO or add a billing tolerance policy.
Maria F.: Great. I'll document this case in the vendor ticket: "Cohesive invoice missing PO on PDF; reissued INV-2026-0421-R1 to match PO-77892; charge GL 5002-ML-INF; routing to Anika." Closing once invoice is matched. :white_check_mark:
Invoices Bot: Invoice INV-2026-0421-R1 uploaded by Cohesive AP • Status: pending match.
Anika (Finance Manager): I'll review as soon as it's routed. Thanks for flagging.
Cohesive AP: Confirmed — payment terms unchanged. Let us know if you need any additional remittance info. :handshake:
Maria F.: Noted. Will update when payment scheduled.
